nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd internal pure arithmetic helper performing checked addition with assert.
SafeMath.safeSub internal pure arithmetic helper performing checked subtraction with assert.
SafeMath.safeMul internal pure arithmetic helper performing checked multiplication with assert.
Constant total token supply initialized to 19870624 * 10**18 and minted to the deployer.
Public mapping address => uint256 holding token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 holding approved spending allowances.
Constructor that emits Transfer from address(0) and assigns totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Public transfer that subtracts _value from msg.sender balance and adds it to _to using safeSub/safeAdd.
Public transferFrom that decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] and balanceOf[_from] and credits _to; performs no allowance sufficiency check.
Public approve that requires the new value be zero or the existing allowance be zero, then stores allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, blocking direct ether transfers.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used as balance owner, spender and constructor beneficiary.
Unchecked-allowance-free balance mutation in transfer: balanceOf[msg.sender] reduced via safeSub then balanceOf[_to] increased via safeAdd.
Allowance and balance deduction in transferFrom executed with no verification that allowance[_from][msg.sender] >= _value, enabling spending of arbitrary balances from arbitrary owners.
Fallback function reverts on any plain ether transfer, a hard failure mode for senders.
Destination address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value of transfer, fed into the balance subtraction.
Owner address parameter _from of transferFrom, used to index allowance and balanceOf.
Destination address parameter _to of transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom, subtracted from allowance and balance without a check.
Spender address parameter _spender of approve, used to index allowance[msg.sender].
Allowance amount parameter _value of approve, stored into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Local variable z holding the result of _x + _y inside safeAdd.
Local variable z holding the result of _x * _y inside safeMul.

edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender as the recipient of the initial totalSupply mint.
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender] as the debit source.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to spend _from allowance and balance without verifying allowance[_from][msg.sender] >= _value.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
totalSupply is read in the constructor and written into balanceOf[msg.sender].
_value parameter flows into the transfer balance mutation logic.
_value is the subtrahend passed to safeSub when reducing balanceOf[msg.sender].
balanceOf[msg.sender] is read and reduced inside the transfer arithmetic.
The transfer arithmetic writes the new balance back into balanceOf for sender and recipient.
_to parameter determines the credited balanceOf entry in transfer.
_from parameter indexes allowance and balanceOf in the unchecked transferFrom deductions.
_value is subtracted from allowance and balance in transferFrom without a sufficiency check.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and reduced by _value in transferFrom.
The reduced allowance result is written back to the allowance mapping.
balanceOf[_from] is read and reduced in transferFrom before crediting _to.
_to parameter determines the credited balanceOf entry in transferFrom.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping together with msg.sender in approve.
_value is stored as the new allowance[msg.sender][_spender] value.
transfer invokes safeSub to perform the checked balance subtraction.
transfer invokes safeAdd to perform the checked balance addition.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for both the allowance and balance deductions.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the destination balance.
Local z holds the checked sum computed inside safeAdd.
Local z holds the product computed inside safeMul.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a call parameter that only exists to feed transfer's balanceOf credit logic.
_value is a call parameter of transfer that flows directly into the safeSub balance deduction.
_from is a call parameter of transferFrom used solely to index allowance and balanceOf.
_to is a call parameter of transferFrom used solely to credit the destination balance.
_value is a call parameter of transferFrom consumed by the unchecked allowance/balance deductions.
_spender is a call parameter of approve used only as the allowance mapping key.
_value is a call parameter of approve stored directly into the allowance mapping.
z is a temporary local computed and returned immediately inside safeAdd.
z is a temporary local computed and returned immediately inside safeMul.
